title: BFB's Hair Removal Mod
description: Are you tired of the same-old, boring-old easy, relaxing game? Do you not like your hair? Are you a content grabby yt channel? Fear not, I got you covered!
body:
Yep. It's hard. This has been a personal projects to learn mixins, so as a result the archetecture is super hacky. And indeed it's a bit of a shitpost. But, be you the goobers who watched me figure out why a cat crashed the game, or the one NPC that found this normally, you should give it a go.

CURRENTY THERE IS A BUG THAT CAUSES SERVER/ ISERVER CRASHES!
I AM INVESTIGATING THE ISSUE!

I have a few planned updates and bugfixes, but otherwise it's more or less finalized. 

Please share your complaints in [here](https://discord.gg/TWubqCpnmA)!
Also, updates and random bs in there as well.

Full feature list:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Intentional game mechanic, everywhere.
- Darkness can and will kill you.
- Added stamina: actions take a bit of stamina, stamina regenerates over time. Max stamina depends on the balance of your diet.
- Creepers now explode instantly, and move quickly and chaotically.
- On world load, the difficulty is set to hard.
- Skeletons now fire much more often and deal more damage.
- Spiders now pounce higher and have more health, take less fall damage and move faster.
- Zombies now don't burn in sunlight, don't drown and move significantly faster.

</details>
